newsitem.title: USA: USDA starts new cattle market report Friday.
newsitem.headline: USDA starts new cattle market report Friday.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department expects to begin two new cattle market reports in the next several days, a USDA official said Thursday.
The reports follow from recommendations made by USDA's advisory committee on agricultural concentration for reducing the market power of meat packers.
USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) will start a weekly report Friday giving the number of contract cattle traded, broken down by the type of contract, the official said.
On Monday, AMS will start a weekly report on the premiums and discounts of cattle traded, for different grades and weights, the official said.
Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman is expected to make an announcement on the reports during a trip to South Dakota Friday, the official said.
